reply_text:
I told Ilse in her DM thread that her Quarrendon Freight Lines dock is Bay 30, which she told me on 14 Oct.

The private note I saved in gbrain didn't come back when I searched for it. This connection can apparently only look up notes that are visible to everyone. So I took the answer from her own DM history with me, which she can see herself.

That means the private note can be saved but not looked up later from here. For things members ask me to remember privately, their DM history is what actually works for answering them.
